title: Evaluation of a dual Walsh character
statement: Let $V$ be an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $\psi$ be a linear functional on $V$, and let $x\in V$. The Walsh character associated with $\psi$, evaluated at $x$, is the binary sign of $\psi(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$
